items.h: Bitget CEO suspects North Korea behind $352M hack, citing IP clues
items.s: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen said a preliminary investigation found IP addresses matching VPN choices associated with a DPRK hacking group.

items.h: KelpDAO Files BC Civil Claim Against LayerZero
items.s: LayerZero CEO Bryan Pellegrino says he is also named in the claim and calls it 'meritless,' promising to defend himself in Vancouver.

items.h: Asia dominates Crypto Adoption Index, Bitget’s $352M hack: Asia Express
items.s: The APAC region accounts for half of the Global Crypto Adoption Index. Bitget suffers massive $352M loss and OpenAI forgets to mention its agents hacked the Australian Government.
